title: A Fair Hand
description: Felix wants to make a new deck of cards, but the request hides a more personal story.
completion_text: Felix sets aside the performance and tells you the truth about why the game matters.

stages.title: A Fair Hand
stages.lead: Make paper for a replacement deck, then ask Felix why the cards matter.
notes: A personal request from Felix. The quest is only offered through their friendship dialogue.

objectives.description: Speak honestly with Felix about his old card games.
